RUN.about: Cut by the lifecycle of a KRaft cluster — format storage, boot processes, register nodes, run the controller event loop, decide resource state, propagate metadata to brokers — the sequence a control-plane engineer follows.

issues.title: Registration timeout shuts down the broker
issues.detail: If initial registration does not succeed within `initialRegistrationTimeoutMs`, the broker shuts down unconditionally. There is no retry across this deadline — only retries within it.

issues.title: Offline dir failure triggers forced shutdown
issues.detail: If an offline log directory cannot be communicated to the controller within the timeout, the broker calls the shutdown hook, bypassing controlled shutdown entirely.

issues.title: Partial state when unregister fails after remove
issues.detail: removeRaftVoter and unregisterController are two separate RPCs with no transaction. If the first succeeds but the second fails, the controller is removed from the voter set but its registration record remains. The error message guides the user to run kafka-cluster.sh unregister-controller manually.
